{{- /* creator/folder-icon.html — (dict "node" "size" 24) Order (arch/26 §2.3): folder index.md `icon` → name keyword map → seedling. `icon` may be a growth stage (seedling/budding/evergreen) or a sprite name (document-text, calendar-days, pattern, presentation-chart-line, microphone, book-open, cube, paper-clip, user-circle, hashtag, folder). */ -}} {{- $n := .node -}} {{- $px := .size | default 24 -}} {{- $key := lower (printf "%s %s" $n.slug $n.title) -}} {{- $name := "" -}} {{- $map := slice (slice "document-text" "essay" "article" "writing" "文章") (slice "budding" "note" "garden" "笔记") (slice "calendar-days" "daily" "journal" "log" "diary" "日记") (slice "pattern" "pattern") (slice "presentation-chart-line" "talk" "slides") (slice "microphone" "podcast") (slice "book-open" "book" "reading") (slice "cube" "project") (slice "paper-clip" "tool" "resource" "link") (slice "user-circle" "now" "about") (slice "hashtag" "tag" "topic") -}} {{- with $n.icon -}}{{- $name = . -}}{{- end -}} {{- if not $name -}} {{- range $map -}} {{- if not $name -}} {{- $icon := index . 0 -}} {{- range $i, $kw := . -}} {{- if and (gt $i 0) (not $name) (strings.Contains $key $kw) -}}{{- $name = $icon -}}{{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $name = $name | default "seedling" -}} {{- if in (slice "seedling" "budding" "evergreen") $name -}} {{- partial "creator/growth-icon.html" (dict "stage" $name "size" $px) -}} {{- else -}} {{- partial "creator/icon.html" (dict "name" $name "size" $px "class" "cr-folder-icon") -}} {{- end -}}
